name: pollution_deal_rounding
description: Test 23 (spec answer PO1). n := rhe(f32(amount x 0.1f)): 0.1f is the float32 constant 0.100000001490116, the int32 amount enters the multiply exactly, the product is rounded to float32 once, then rounded half to even with the 1.5 x 2^23 idiom (crime.md 6 rhe). By hand and an independent numpy float32 model: 25 -> 2.5000000372 -> f32 2.5 -> 2 (a single rounding of the exact product would give 3); 35 -> 3.5 -> 4; 15 -> 1.5 -> 2; 1000 -> 100. importTotal 108, imported += 108, each import deal's amountUsed = n; a deal with amountUsed = amount (10 of 10) is skipped. Export deal 25 with amountUsed 24: room 1 -> n = min(2, 1) = 1 -> amountUsed 25, exportCapacity 1. Beyond 2^22 the idiom is not exact (test 19 of crime): amount 41,943,040 -> f32 4,194,304 -> 4,194,304 (the largest exact case); amount 50,000,000 -> f32 5,000,000 -> rhe 4,597,152 (17,582,912 = 0x4B8625A0 - 0x4B400000). No tract visits (tractsPerDay 0).
